ABOUT KLEZA

Where complexity meets clarity.
That’s where Kleza makes a difference.

A team that works as an extension of yours, building everything from websites and apps to AI trained on your own business.

Scroll to explore
WHO WE ARE

We built Kleza because small businesses deserved the same AI advantage as the enterprises that could afford it.

Kleza didn't start out chasing trends. It started with a problem we kept seeing everywhere, small and mid-sized businesses wanted the same quality and results that big enterprises could afford, but never had access to the same tools or budgets. So we set out to close that gap, and we're still closing it today, one client at a time.

For years, our growth had nothing to do with any single technology, it came from doing good work and earning trust the hard way. Then, as the tools available to businesses started changing, we didn't rush in just to keep up. We took the time to learn it properly, and built it into how we already worked, so it strengthened our team instead of replacing it.

Along the way, healthcare became where we proved ourselves the most. It's an industry with no room for mistakes, and working with home care agencies, hospitals, pharmacies, and health-tech companies across the USA taught us exactly what "getting it right" means, and what it costs to get it wrong. Those same standards now go into everything we build, for every business we work with. Today, that promise is carried forward by a team of more than 60 people in Hyderabad, India, who bring the same care, precision, and honest effort to every single project. We're Kleza Solutions. What you get from us is simple: solid engineering, smart technology, and people who are genuinely invested in getting it right for you, every time.

With Kleza, you're not keeping up with the future. You're building it.

OUR VISION

We don't chase every AI trend. We build what actually moves your business forward.

01

Your data stays yours

We don't train other systems on your data, and we don't sell or share it. What's built for your business stays yours, full stop.

02

Someone is always accountable

No output ships without a person responsible for it. If something goes wrong, you get a name and a fix, never "the AI did it.

03

We tell you what it can't do, too

We're upfront about where a system's limits are, because knowing where human judgment still has to take over matters more than a polished pitch.

“

Real progress isn't AI instead of people. It's AI in the hands of people who know exactly what they're doing.

HEALTHCARE INNOVATION

We didn't chase the hardest vertical.
We just kept getting it right.

We didn't plan to become a healthcare-focused company. It happened because we kept solving healthcare's hardest problems well, regulatory complexity, staffing pressure, documentation overload, and the real human stakes behind every one of them.

Today, our clients span home care agencies, pharmacies, therapists, hospitals, and family physicians. We understand this industry not from a market study, but from years of doing the work inside it.

MILESTONES

How we got here.

2020

Founded

Kleza Solutions opened in Hyderabad, built to give smaller businesses an enterprise-grade edge.

2021

Going Global

We opened operations in Overland Park, Kansas, extending delivery across North American time zones.

2022

Deep Domain Expertise

Our first major healthcare engagements taught us to master high-stakes work where getting it right is everything.

2023

The AI Shift

We made AI the core of everything we do, evolving from a digital services company into an AI-first one.

2025

IVNA Launch

We launched IVNA.ai, our AI products platform, starting with Voica AI and Pulse Board.

2026

Full Ecosystem

Kleza now runs as one connected ecosystem, uniting AI products, AI services and enterprise solutions across the USA and India.
